media:group.media:title: 7 Hours of Ambient Hiking Footage
media:group.media:description:
Twelve of my hiking trips from 2024 to 2026, each one start to finish, with the sponsor and talking parts taken out. From sunrise above the clouds in the Dolomites and the Tian Shan in Kyrgyzstan to K2, Lofoten, Patagonia and the Peaks of the Balkans. The sound of the trail, calm music, and no narration.
0:00 Alta Via 1, Dolomites, Italy https://kraigadams.com/guides/alta-via-1?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 1:07:57 Ak-Suu Traverse, Tian Shan, Kyrgyzstan https://kraigadams.com/guides/ak-suu?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 1:46:20 K2 Base Camp trek, Karakoram, Pakistan https://kraigadams.com/guides/k2-base-camp?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 2:18:46 Lofoten Islands, Norway https://kraigadams.com/guides/lofoten?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 3:36:56 Skye Trail, Scotland https://kraigadams.com/guides/skye-trail?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 3:59:48 Haute Route, Chamonix to Zermatt, France and Switzerland https://kraigadams.com/guides/haute-route?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 4:45:14 Dientes de Navarino, Chile https://kraigadams.com/guides/dientes-de-navarino?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 5:02:59 GR221 Dry Stone Route, Mallorca, Spain https://kraigadams.com/guides/gr221?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 5:38:29 Glacier National Park, Montana, USA https://kraigadams.com/guides/glacier-north-loop?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 5:52:28 Cerro Huemul Circuit, El Chaltén, Argentina https://kraigadams.com/guides/cerro-huemul?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 6:20:49 Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain https://kraigadams.com/guides/canary-islands?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw 6:33:17 Peaks of the Balkans, Kosovo, Montenegro and Albania https://kraigadams.com/guides/peaks-of-the-balkans?ref=yt-desc-2upU96IeRlw
